newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Hicom, Proton to post six-month results.
newsitem.headline: Hicom, Proton to post six-month results.

text.p: Malaysian automotive group Hicom Holdings Bhd and associate Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) said they will release their half-year results later on Wednesday.
The firms will hold a news conference at 6.00 p.m. (1000 GMT) to announce results for the six months ended September 30, 1996, a statement from the companies said.
For the 1995 half-year, Hicom, which is also involved in cement making, reported net profit of 120.15 million ringgit and turnover of 295.13 million ringgit.
Proton, the national car maker, posted net profit of 114.99 million ringgit and turnover of 2.50 billion ringgit for the 1995 six months.
Analysts have forecast Proton's pre-tax profit for the first six months at 450 million ringgit against 127.3 million in the corresponding period of last year.
